slides.texte_overlay:
fabrics every elegant woman
should know

silk

spun by silkworms
for their cocoons.

linen

woven from flax, one of the
oldest fabrics in the world.

alpaca

warmer and lighter than wool.

poplin

the crisp cotton of
a perfect shirt.

crêpe de chine

a fluid, matte silk.

organza

sheer and stiff, for evening.

learning one new thing a day beats
an hour of scrolling.
